text:
The abstract describes synthesis of a polyacrylamide–TiO₂ nanocomposite (PAA@TiO₂) and demonstrates its adsorption capacity for crystal violet (≈38.9 mg g⁻¹) together with molecular‑simulation evidence of favorable adsorption energetics. No biochar, bacterial consortia, ZnO, quaternary‑ammonium modifications, photocatalytic degradation, or alkali‑treated date stones are reported. Consequently, none of the four candidate hypotheses aligns with the main hypothesis validated by this study.
